text:
elaine: Quick sync: we need to finalize RBAC + audit steps for the base-image key-roll next Thurs 07:30 PT. Main concerns: who can change runtime trust anchors, where attestations are archived, and KMS key policy.

jon: Can we make the signer a short-lived workload identity with kms:Sign only? No pushes or artifacts writes.

priya: Agreed. Also require signer pods to call KMS directly (no secret material in k8s). Use OIDC + Workload Identity.

security-bot: Compliance check: ensure audit logs for key usage and attestation verification are exported to the SOX bucket and retained 180 days. Add to runbook.

elaine: Proposal: groups `sec-crypto` + `platform-release` can mutate trust anchors; changes require 2 approvers via gitops PR. No manual console edits.

jon: Storage: keep attestations as OCI artifacts; additionally snapshot attestations/SBOMs to a dated prefix `gs://redwood-audits/attest-snapshots/YYYYMMDD/` with immutability lock for 30 days.

priya: For rollout, canary in us-west-2 for 2h accepting both keys, alert on verification_error_rate > 0.25% for 10m. Auto rollback if >2% for 5m.

ops-oncall: I'll add alerts and a pager for the window. Also add an incident play entry to handle signature mapping when failures show unknown key IDs.

elaine: Vulnerability triage note: if a rebuild is triggered by CVE, signer rotation can be decoupled but we must re-sign rebuilt images and re-run SBOM verification. Log rebuild reason in attestation metadata.

security-bot: Runbook checklist suggestion: create HSM-backed KMS key, provision workload identity, grant kms:Sign + kms:GetPublicKey, update gitops trust anchors (2 approvers), sign canary, snapshot attest/SBOM, export to archival bucket, monitor, revoke old key after 7 days.

priya: One extra: add a post-rotation audit task to sample 100 images and verify attestation+SBOM hash matches archival copy.

elaine: Thanks team. I'll push the draft runbook to PR and tag sec-crypto for review.
